title: Annotated decision logbook with SLO correlations for smart routing
creator: Aisha Kumar
description: Goal: Improve visibility into per-request routing decisions across region selection, tier routing, and fallback model variants by producing an "annotated decision logbook" that ties routing verdicts to SLO outcomes. The feature should produce compact, searchable decision records that include per-hop micro-metrics, rationale tags (cost/latency/affinity), and model-variant metadata. Records must be queryable in the Console for post-hoc RCA and automatically correlated with latency/cost SLO breaches. Requirements: (1) Add a minimal per-request decision envelope emitted at routing time with optional sampled frames for large context; (2) Include deterministic decision IDs and hop indexes for joinability with traces; (3) Emit SLO correlation markers derived from runtime SLO engine (e.g., overshoot/latency buckets); (4) Backwards-compatible schema with opt-in enrichment to limit storage/cost; (5) Privacy: strip PII from attached prompt frames per policy. Deliverables: design doc, schema migration, instrumentation PR, prototype dashboard and rollout plan.
acceptance_criteria: Decision envelope is emitted for 100% of routed requests and ingested by the telemetry pipeline
Per-hop micro-metrics (queue_ms, dispatch_ms, model_variant, bytes_sent, bytes_received) available in Console within 30 seconds
SLO correlation tag attached to envelopes for any request flagged as above-threshold
No PII or full prompt text present in default envelopes; sampled frames require opt-in flag
End-to-end pipeline benchmark shows <5% added p50 latency at the routing decision path with sampling off
Migration path and schema versioning documented and backward compatible for older consumers
comments: 2026-03-02 - Aisha Kumar: Kickoff spike finished. Validated proto approach: lightweight 'decision envelope' protobuf with optional Base64 compressed frame. Measured envelope size ~250 bytes uncompressed. Spike notes in Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/INFR/Annotated+Decision+Logbook

2026-03-04 - Liam Chen: Design review with observability and SRE. Decided to attach deterministic decision_id (UUIDv5) computed from request metadata to allow joins without storing full prompt. Agreement to use hop_index and hop_role tags (router, region-proxy, model-pool).

2026-03-06 - Sofia Martinez (Console): Prototype Console panel mocked — shows timeline with decision hops, per-hop latency bars, and SLO markers. UX note: collapse sampled frames behind a 'Reveal' button to enforce opt-in. Mock link: https://drive.redwood.ai/drive/u/0/folders/decision-logbook-mock

2026-03-08 - Liam Chen: Instrumentation PR created for router service. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/router/pull/1245. Initial tests show ~3.4% p50 amplification for routes instrumented with full envelopes (no sampling).

2026-03-10 - Security review (internal): Raised concern about inadvertent prompt leakage in sampled frames. Action: implement client opt-in plus automated scrubber pipeline. Added 'scrubbed' boolean to schema. Link to security note: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/SEC/Decision+Log+PII+Controls

2026-03-12 - Observability: Pipeline ingestion prototype landed. Implemented lightweight indexer that extracts decision_id, hop_index, model_variant, region, tier, and slo_tags to a columnar store. Prototype query shows region+variant heatmap correlated with latency SLO violations. Dashboard prototype: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/decision-logbook/proto

2026-03-14 - Aisha Kumar: Planning rollout. Rollout plan: enable envelopes in staging for 100% traffic with sampled frames off (default), validate dashboards and storage costs, then enable sampling at 1% for production to test frame scrubber. Follow-ups: finalize retention policy and compaction rules; estimate storage add: ~120GB/month for 10M requests with sampling off (envelopes only).
